profiles.rule: Keep the zero-joint standing goal and existing speed/cap bounds. Each target advances from the actual measured joint position by outer_step_duration_s times clamp(position_error / response_time_s, -maximum_target_speed_rad_s, maximum_target_speed_rad_s). No force feedback or observation rewrite.
profiles.parameter_basis: Development design choice: distribute near-goal position correction over 0.1 seconds (12 nominal outer steps), instead of demanding correction within one 1/120-second step. This is a controller parameter, not a changed success threshold or an empirically proved optimum.
